definition: Paid renewal invoice without an exact teacher form invoice_id match
formula: count eligible invoice IDs without exact form link / count eligible paid renewal invoice IDs
limitations: Eligibility is literal payment_status=Paid and is_renewal=Yes. Null deleted_at not interpreted. A same-student form is not treated as an exact invoice match.

definition: Eligible paid renewal invoices with at least one exact form match
formula: count distinct eligible invoice IDs matched / count eligible paid renewal invoice IDs
limitations: Distinct invoice IDs prevent duplicate form references from inflating the rate.

definition: Form rows whose invoice_id occurs on more than one form
formula: count forms with repeated invoice_id / count all forms
limitations: Affected-form rate; one repeated invoice value affects two forms. Does not determine which form is canonical.

definition: Matched form/invoice pairs where amount_paid differs exactly from invoice net_amount
formula: count matched form rows with amount_paid != net_amount / count matched form rows
limitations: One mismatch is on a partially paid invoice: net_amount 5250 vs form amount_paid 10500. Field semantics need confirmation; exact numeric comparison used.

definition: Teacher forms with at least one linked booking request
formula: count distinct form IDs in booking_requests.faculty_form_id / count forms
limitations: Snapshot conversion, not an SLA result. No deleted_at filtering because lifecycle meaning is unknown.

definition: Forms whose approval_status is exactly Pending
formula: count forms where approval_status=Pending / count forms
limitations: Pending is not proof that SLA elapsed; extract has no authoritative as-of time or SLA target.

definition: Requests linked to Approved forms with no schedule row
formula: count approved-form requests without schedule / count requests linked to Approved forms
limitations: Missing schedule is point-in-time only; statuses differ and SLA is unknown.

formula: count requests where request_status=Failed_Batch_Full / count booking requests
limitations: Reference snapshot has no timestamp; it cannot independently confirm live capacity or cause.

definition: Median elapsed time from eligible invoice payment to first linked non-cancelled schedule creation
formula: median(earliest schedule created_at - paid_at), exact invoice_id join
limitations: Only one invoice has a valid eligible paid invoice/schedule pair; not a stable service estimate. Timezone is unspecified.

definition: Eligible paid renewal invoices with one or more observable linkage/duplicate/pending/failed/allocation/selection signals
formula: count distinct eligible paid invoice IDs with any enumerated review signal / count eligible paid renewal invoice IDs
datasets: All four operational CSVs; reference CSV for provisional capacity context
limitations: Proposed review-signal metric, not confirmed failure or leakage. Pending states may be within SLA.
